strings.괜찮아요. 그런데 무슨 부탁을 하고 싶으신 건가요?: It's all right. What favor did you want to ask?
It's about the Dragon Emperor's Palace here in Yong Gyoung.
She says she's fine and still has strength to spare, but she looked exhausted.
strings.더는 지켜볼 수 없어서 %s 님에게 연락드린 거예요. 그분께서 독단적이라: I couldn't keep watching, so I contacted you, %s. Even if she scolds me for acting on my own, it couldn't be helped.
I've kept hearing about your achievements, %s.
I decided this was the time we needed your strength, %s.
strings.좋게 평가해주시니 고마워요. 무슨 일인지 궁금해요. 설명해주실래요?: Thank you for thinking so highly of me. I'm curious what happened. Could you explain?
Here in Yong Gyoung, there is a vast palace isolated within a powerful spatial barrier.
I think I vaguely remember it.
The spatial barrier isolating the palace is called, if I recall...
One of the Great Miracle Secret Arts, which separates a designated place from space and time.
strings.결계가 유지되고 있는 동안, 누구도 침입할 수 없고 반대로 내부에 있는: While the barrier remains, nobody can enter, and nothing inside can escape.
That's because time in the isolated space comes to a halt.
strings.용경 제국을 세운 '용제'의 혈족 중에서도 빼어난 재능을 지닌 이들만이: It was a secret art usable only by exceptionally gifted descendants of the Dragon Emperor, founder of the Yong Gyoung Empire.
But recently, the palace's barrier broke.
strings.그렇게 되면서 멈춰진 시간 속에 400년 동안 갇혀 있던 용경군이 깨어나: The Yong Gyoung troops, trapped in stopped time for four hundred years, awakened and began moving again.
No, nothing. It just makes my heart feel heavy...
strings.아무튼 용경군은 위험해요. 용경군을 그렇게 만들었던 용제는 더욱 사악한: Anyway, the Yong Gyoung army is dangerous. The Dragon Emperor, who made them what they are, has become an even more wicked demon.
strings.힘을 원해서 인간이길 거부한 황제와 그런 황제가 악마의 힘으로 억지로 강: An emperor who rejected humanity for power, and an army he forcibly strengthened with demonic power... Honestly...
Then we need to stop them.
Yes. We must fight the forces inside the Dragon Emperor's Palace.
Follow the path through the Red Crop Field that appears only late at night, and you'll meet her.
strings.%s 님의 도움이 절실하게 필요해요. 그러니 외면하지 마시고 꼭 '붉은: We desperately need your help, %s. Please don't turn away. Go to the 'Red Crop Field (Midnight)'!
Hello. I'm %s. Akyung asked me to come.
Are you the commander here? Of the forces fighting the Yong Gyoung army...?
So you've heard some of the situation.
Yes. I command the Jiendia Imperial Army... My name is Jiendia.
strings.지엔디아 제국은 과거에 지엔디아 대륙의 중심부에 있던 나라였지만, 지금은: Our empire once stood at the heart of the Jiendia continent. Now it quietly survives in one corner of it.
I came here to sever an old, bitter bond. My bond with the Dragon Emperor...
strings.폐하! 지금 막 호랑사의 호선께서 도착하셨습니다! 바로 용제성에 진입하셨: Your Majesty! The Tiger Immortal from the Tiger Temple has just arrived! She has already entered the Dragon Emperor's Palace!
So the Tiger Immortal has finally arrived...
strings.병사여, 배치된 병력에게 전하세요. 호선 레이레이님의 지시를 받아 움직이: Soldier, tell the deployed troops to follow Lady Leilei's instructions.
strings.호선께서 오셨으니 별일이 없길 바라야겠죠. 아, 어디까지 이야기를 했었죠: Now that she's here, we can hope nothing goes wrong. Ah, where was I?
Yes, a little... When I heard your name, I thought it was unusual. So you really are...
Please be at ease with me.
strings.사람들의 안전과 대륙의 평화를 위해 많은 위험한 일에 나서주셔서 감사드려: Thank you for facing so many dangers for people's safety and the continent's peace. Shall we get to the matter at hand?
strings.(지엔디아가 숨을 고르자 주위에 흐르고 있던 공기의 느낌이 달라지는 것: (As Jiendia steadies her breathing, the atmosphere around her seems to change.)
strings.400년 전, 용경의 멸망은 용경 제국의 지배자인 용제와 그 아들인 기이: Four hundred years ago, Yong Gyoung's downfall began with a conflict between the Dragon Emperor, ruler of the empire, and his son, Crown Prince Guiyi.
strings.언제부턴가 용제는 갑자기 폭군으로 변해, 아들기이의 약혼녀이자 동맹국의: At some point, the Dragon Emperor suddenly became a tyrant. He tried to offer his son's betrothed, a princess of an allied country, as a sacrifice to a demon.
strings.게다가 지엔디아 대륙의 모든 나라를 정복할 생각으로 전쟁을 일으키려 했어: He also intended to start a war to conquer every nation on Jiendia, using demonic power...
Prince Guiyi rose to stop his father's tyranny and chose to sacrifice himself. He activated the Barrier of Time and isolated this place from the present world forever, knowing what that choice meant for him...
strings.그렇게 400년이 지난 어느 날, 결계가 부서졌어요. 누군가 일부러 그런: Then, one day after four hundred years, the barrier broke. As if someone had done it deliberately... Since the army has awakened and begun moving, the Dragon Emperor must have awakened too.
strings.누가 결계를 부쉈는지 찾아내야 해요. 그리고 과거엔 하지 못했던 용제를: We must find whoever broke the barrier, and defeat the Dragon Emperor and his army, as we could not in the past. That is what I, who live bound by time, must do...
Will taking down the palace take a long time? You seem very short-handed...
Many of the empire's people are deployed on other operations.
strings.무엇보다도 이 일은 제가 직접 해결해야 할 개인적인 은원과도 같은 문제라: And above all, this is a personal matter of old debts and grudges that I must settle myself...
That's why I came to Yong Gyoung with only the small force available at once.
strings.용제성을 방어하는 용경군들의 처치를 부탁드릴게요. 정예 병사 몇이 성에: Please defeat the Yong Gyoung troops defending the palace. A few elite soldiers have infiltrated it, but I can't be certain they'll succeed...
strings.물론, 저희 병사들을 믿지만 이곳은 특별한 사람의 힘이 필요합니다. 마치: Of course I trust our soldiers, but this place needs someone with unusual strength. Someone like you...
Please help deal with the defensive troops around the palace.
...We've received some unusual intelligence that you should hear.
strings.첩보 중에 처치한 용경군이 희미한 마력이 담겨 있는 '마석'을 지니고 있: One report says the defeated Yong Gyoung soldiers carried 'magic stones' containing faint magical energy.
strings.아시겠지만 지금 용경군은 일반적인 인간의 힘이 아니에요. 가지고 있는 마: As you know, the army's strength is no longer that of ordinary humans. The stones they carry are probably the reason.
strings.일단 마석을 구해 살펴봐야겠어요. 용경군이 이런 힘을 낼 수 있는 비밀을: We need to obtain some stones and examine them. We must discover the secret of their strength...
Magic stones that increase strength... What could they be...
strings.저기, 제가 그걸 모아오면 될까요?: Should I gather them for you?
So this is the magic stone in question...
strings.이런…, 마석에 담긴 기운이 너무 희미하네요. 힘의 흡수가 다 끝나서 그: Oh dear... The energy inside it is too faint. Has all its power already been absorbed?
It will be difficult to analyze in this state.
strings.더 강한 존재면 더 강한 마석이 있지 않을까요?: Wouldn't a stronger being have a stronger magic stone?
That might be possible... In that case...
strings.혹시 지금 용경군 중 조금이라도 강한 존재가 있나요?: Are there any particularly strong members of the Yong Gyoung army?
If there are, I should defeat them and bring their stones back.
Hmm, one moment. Ah, there are.
strings.용제성 외곽 지대에 방어를 담당하는 '야수병'이죠. 그들이 일반 용경군의: The Beast Riders who guard the palace's outer grounds. They should be at least twice as strong as ordinary Yong Gyoung soldiers.
strings.야수를 타며 방어선을 지휘하는데…, 병사의 힘도 힘이지만, 야수 또한 악: They ride beasts and command the defensive lines... Be careful. Both the soldiers and their mounts have received demonic power.
The stone's pattern is difficult... More precisely, my knowledge isn't enough to understand it.
strings.저는 제가 어느 정도 마법에 익숙하다고 생각했는데, 이 마석을 본 순간: I thought I was reasonably familiar with magic, but seeing this stone made me doubt that.
strings.마석에 새겨진 마법 술식의 회로 구성 방식이 그래요. 기본적으로 마법사들: The way the magical formula's circuits are arranged inside it. Normally, when mages construct such circuits...
I'm sorry, but could you explain it a little more simply?
The way the magic engraved in this stone is activated is extremely unusual, so it's difficult to analyze.
It doesn't seem to follow an ordinary structure...
We'll need help from someone well versed in this kind of magic.
Lady Leilei, the Tiger Immortal inside the palace...
She should know something. Please ask her.
strings.지엔디아가 이걸 나한테 보여주라고 했다고? 흐음, 뭐지?: Jiendia told you to show this to me? Hmm, what is it?
I'm not a specialist in magical arts like Jeril, so magical theory is a bit difficult for me.
strings.그래도 혹시 모르니 한 번 살펴볼게!: But you never know. I'll take a look!
strings.떠오를 듯 말 듯한 이 더러운 술식 패턴…. 분명히 어디서 봤는데 기억이: This foul pattern... It's right on the tip of my memory. I've definitely seen it somewhere, but I can't remember.
Perhaps too much time has passed...
Still, I have my dignity as an immortal. Wait a moment. Hrrm... Hrrm...
Just a little. It will only take a little while. Wait. Just a moment.
strings.저기 너, 내가 이걸 살펴보고 있을 동안 날 도와줘. 이 근처가 소란스러: You there, help me while I examine this. It's too noisy around here to concentrate. Just help me a little.
strings.간단, 간단, 아주 간단해. 이 안에 있는 나쁜 무리를 쫓아주면 돼. 내: Simple, simple, very simple. Drive out the villains inside here while I concentrate. Just for a moment. Easy, right?
Yes, if it's only a moment...
Lady Leilei, I'll be right back.
strings.으, 으응. 지금 표정이 안 좋았는데, 괜찮은 거야?: O-oh. You looked unwell just now. Are you all right?
strings.네, 저는 괜찮아요. 최대한 시간을 벌테니 그동안 마석에 대해 아는 게: Yes, I'm fine. I'll buy you as much time as I can, so please try to remember anything you know about the stones!
strings.휴우, 기다리고 있었어. 괜찮은 거야?: Phew. I've been waiting. Are you all right?
strings.확실히 용제성에 있는 병사들은 달랐어요. 일반적인 인간과는 다른 움직임…: The soldiers in the palace really were different. They moved unlike ordinary humans...
strings.그 마석은 대체 누가 만든 걸까요?: Who could have made those magic stones?
strings.아가슈라야. 이 마석에 새겨진 특유의 마법 술식 회로 구성은 분명 아가슈: An Agasura. The distinctive arrangement of magical circuits engraved in this stone is definitely Agasura work. I guarantee it! But... Hmm... Something's strange.
strings.아가슈라의 술식을 예전에 본 적이 있는데, 일반적인 형태를 많이 벗어나있: I've seen Agasura formulas before. They were far removed from normal forms. Even immortals couldn't tamper with them. Hmm...
Power beyond even an immortal's reach... Believe me.
strings.다른 선인들도 무시할 수 없는 경계…. 이건 아가슈라 밖에 없어! 아가슈: A boundary even other immortals cannot ignore... It can only be the Agasura! Agasura!
strings.(아가슈라가 왜 대체 이곳에서 무슨 일을 한 거지?): (Why would an Agasura be here, and what were they doing?)
You're not doubting my abilities, are you? Oh, right. There's something I forgot to say.
strings.갑자기 지엔디아가 용제성 안으로 들어갔어!: Jiendia suddenly went farther into the palace!
strings.네가 오는 대로 자기가 있는 곳으로 보내달라고 하더라. 가다 표식을 해뒀: She asked me to send you to her as soon as you arrived. She left signs along the way, so she said you'd find her easily.
You're probably the only one who can see them.
strings.너와 만났을 때, 안전을 위해 마법같은 걸 걸었을 거야. 그러니까 의심하: When she met you, she probably placed some kind of spell on you for your safety. So don't be suspicious!
Jiendia doesn't want anyone else getting hurt because of her.
Because of her...? Oh, and I wasn't being suspicious.
strings.알았어, 알았어. 그러면 바로 지엔디아에게 갈거지?: All right, all right. You're going straight to Jiendia, then?
Yes. Since she's looking for me, I'll go.
Jiendia is complicated. She has a lot of history.
Perhaps you might be able to understand her.
Then I'll go to Her Majesty and tell her exactly what you said.
strings.혹시 더 이야기하고 싶은 말씀 있으세요?: Is there anything else you want to tell her?
All right... I'll pass on what you've told me.
strings.난 여기서 병사들과 최대한 계획대로 움직일테니까 조심해야 해. 알았지?: I'll stay here and do my best to follow the plan with the soldiers. Be careful, all right?
Yes. I'll go inside. You be careful too.
I've already heard the general outline from Lady Leilei.
strings.사실 저도 조금 의심은 하고 있었지만… 역시 아가슈라가 만든 물건이더군요: To be honest, I had my suspicions too... So it really was made by an Agasura.
Lady Leilei is extraordinary! To understand even this...
You trust her a great deal.
strings.물론이죠. 아무튼, 용제성의 결계를 부순 범인의 윤곽이 그려졌으니 이제: Of course. Anyway, now that we have a clearer picture of who broke the barrier, I think we can resolve this.
Once we defeat the master of the palace, everything should end. Surely...
But there's something we must do first.
Our troops who entered Moonflower Garden have gone missing.
The garden's space-time axis seems to have twisted, leaving its paths in chaos.
Yes. The barrier is the cause.
Moonflower Garden was long famous for its abundant, pure energy.
strings.시간의 결계의 영향으로 용제성이 외부 공간과 단절된 동안, 계속 응집되던: While the Barrier of Time cut the palace off from the outside world, energy kept accumulating. The moment the barrier was lifted, that energy erupted.
We can only assume that this affected space and time.
strings.…조금 어려웠죠?: ...That was a little complicated, wasn't it?
strings.이해가 조금 힘들긴 하지만, 확실하게 제가 해야 할 일을 말씀해주시겠어요: It's a little hard to understand. Could you tell me exactly what I need to do?
Check whether the Master of Moonflower Garden is also under the influence of a magic stone.
If the master isn't in his right mind, he must never be allowed outside.
A large magical formation in the garden gathers energy from outside...
And the Master of Moonflower Garden is at its center.
strings.아마도 원주를 처리해야 '축'이 무너지고, 진법이 해체될 거에요. 그러면: Defeating him should collapse the axis and dismantle the formation. Then the distorted flow of space and time should slowly settle.
strings.이런 걸 어떻게 알고 계시나요?: How do you know all this?
Ah, we have no time. Our soldiers keep falling, so we must hurry.
strings.원주를 상대하는 것만으로 이 상황이 빨리 복구가 될 거라 생각하지 않아요: I don't expect defeating the master alone to restore things immediately. I'll gather information and look for a way to resolve it too.
Then I'll be going. Please be careful.
I expected it, but the garden's master really was controlled by a magic stone...
It's tragic. He was a warm person whose love of flowers reflected his heart...
Now that he's gone, the garden's distorted space and time should soon return to normal.
Then it's time to go to the place where this tragedy began.
strings.저는 괜찮아요. 그러면 용황전 이야기를 할게요. 이곳을 이렇게 만든 황제: I'm fine. Let me tell you about the Dragon Emperor's Hall. It is where the emperor who made this place what it is now resides.
To preserve his royal authority, he became so suspicious and afraid of even his own son...
strings.마계의 군주 럭스를 찾았고 거래 조건으로 영혼을 걸었죠. 타락한 용이 되: He sought out Lux, lord of the demon realm, and wagered his soul in the bargain. A pathetic, unworthy ruler who believed that as a fallen dragon, he could devour everything...
strings.그리고 그곳엔 타락한 용을 저지하고자 자신조차 희생한 위대한 남자도 있어: And there is also a great man there who sacrificed even himself to stop that fallen dragon.
Prince Guiyi... Though perhaps he is no longer a crown prince.
strings.(지엔디아의 눈빛이 흘들리고 있을 때, 저 멀리 병사가 난처한 표정으로: (As Jiendia's gaze wavers, a soldier runs toward her from the distance, looking distressed.)
strings.폐하! 호선께서 지원을 요청하셨습니다. 현재 용제군이 밖으로 나가려고 해: Your Majesty! Lady Leilei requests reinforcements! The Dragon Emperor's forces are trying to escape, and she is holding them back with the remaining troops!
strings.네, 알겠습니다. %s, 이제 대화를 마무리하고 한 번 만 더 부탁을 드: Understood. %s, we must end our conversation. I have one more request, as the ruler of a nation, however small...
strings.용제성 입구는 지금 복잡하지 않을테니 들어가 어리석은 황제를 만나 처단해: The palace entrance should be relatively clear now. Go inside, confront that foolish emperor, and bring him down. Then bring me the magic stone he carries.
strings.그동안 저도 호선을 도울 예정입니다. 타락한 용을 끝내야 시간의 경계에: I'll help Lady Leilei in the meantime. Ending the fallen dragon is the only way to sever everything bound at the boundary of time...
strings.(타락한 용…, 시간의 경계…. 복잡하지만 그래도 해야할 일이겠지….): (A fallen dragon... the boundary of time... It's complicated, but it's something I have to do...)
strings.나는 왜 아직도 죽지 않은 것이냐. 필시 나는 용으로 변한 아바마마를 막: Why am I still alive? To stop my father after he became a dragon, I surely used the secret art passed down through the royal family...
I activated the Great Miracle Secret Art, the barrier called 'Stopped Time.'
And I too became trapped inside... Yes, I remember.
Are you all right? I'd like to give you some medicine...
I'm sorry I cannot accept your kindness. This isn't pain medicine can heal...
strings.이건 영과 육이 강제로 분리되어 버린 탓에 발생한 반발력…. 누군가 이런: This is the backlash caused by my spirit and body being forcibly separated... Someone did this...
strings.기이 님, 혹시 성의 결계를 해제하고 마석을 사용한 자들을 보셨나요?: Guiyi, did you see the people who removed the palace's barrier and used the magic stones?
Lady Leilei says it was the work of the Agasura...
strings.자, 잠깐. 자네, 지엔디아라고 했나? 폐하? 그럼 그녀가 황제가 된 것: W-wait. Did you say Jiendia? Her Majesty? Then she has become an empress?
If you mean the time since the palace was sealed... About four hundred years have passed.
strings.400년?! 그, 그러면 용경 제국은?: Four hundred years?! Th-then what of the Yong Gyoung Empire?
strings.네, 사라졌어요. 지금 지엔디아 대륙은 엘리아스 왕국을 비롯해 여러 세력: It's gone. The Jiendia continent is now governed by the Kingdom of Elias and several other powers.
strings.그분께서 병력을 이끌고 깨어난 용제성 앞을 막고 계세요. 용제성 안의 존: She is leading troops to hold back the awakened palace, so the beings inside cannot escape...
strings.(그러고보니 폐하께선 나이가 400세가 넘으신 건가….): (Come to think of it, does that mean Her Majesty is over four hundred years old...?)
strings.살아있군. 그래, 잘 살아있구나. 그래, 내 시간은 멈췄지만, 그녀의 시: She's alive. Yes, she's alive and well. My time stopped, but hers continued...
strings.내 아비, 폭군이었던 황제는 아들인 내가 자신을 몰아낼 거란 망상에 사로: My father, the tyrant emperor, was consumed by the delusion that I would overthrow him. He must have thought I was raising an army to seize power.
strings.어디선가 마계의 군주 럭스를 찾아 영혼을 팔았다. 그리고 그 대가로 힘을: Somewhere, he found Lux, lord of the demon realm, and sold his soul. In return, he gained power and became a fallen dragon.
strings.결국 그것도 럭스의 뜻대로 된 것…. 황제는 럭스를 이 땅에 부르기 위: In the end, that too was according to Lux's wishes... To summon Lux to this land, the emperor abducted my betrothed, Jiendia.
strings.제단에 올라가는 제물처럼 그녀를 바치고, 그녀의 힘을 이용해 나타나려고: He offered her as a sacrifice on the altar, intending to use her power to let Lux appear.
strings.폐하가 신의 혈통이란 말씀이신가요?: Are you saying Her Majesty has divine blood?
I cannot say precisely, but I understand such beings are called Demigods.
strings.신의 혈통을 지닌 그녀만이 마계의 힘을 일부 쥐고 있는 럭스를 감당할만한: Only she, with divine blood, could serve as a vessel capable of containing Lux, who holds part of the demon realm's power.
By the time I learned the truth, the ritual was already halfway complete.
strings.내가 가족으로 여기던 호위무사의 도움으로 지엔디아를 구해낼 수 있었다만…: With the help of a bodyguard I regarded as family, I managed to save Jiendia... But I never imagined she would become someone forced to endure such a long span of time.
strings.(아무렇지도 않게 이야기를 이어가고 있던 기이의 표정이 슬퍼보인다.): (Guiyi, who had been speaking calmly, suddenly looks sorrowful.)
strings.아, 미안하다. 이야기가 끊겼군. 난 힘이 없었다. 힘이 있다한들 영혼을: Ah, forgive me. I lost my train of thought. I had no strength. Even what strength I had was insufficient to stop the fallen dragon whose soul had been consumed by darkness.
strings.당시 제국은 황제의 폭정 탓에 정상이 아니었다. 그런 와중에 타락한 용이: The empire was already in turmoil because of the emperor's tyranny. If a fallen dragon appeared amid that...
strings.나는 차마 그 모습을 볼 수 없었다. 오랜 시간을 백성을 위해 살던 우리: I couldn't bear to watch. Not the collapse of the land where we had lived for our people for so long...
When the fallen dragon appeared before me, I made my choice. Sigh...
I did hope my bodyguard would unravel the tangled threads of fate...
strings.너를 신뢰하겠다. 그러니 지엔디아에게 가서 전해다오. 당신이 그랬던 것처: I will trust you. Go and tell her that, just as she endured, I too will hold on however I can and find a way to return to my original body.
Yes, I'll tell her. But please meet her yourself someday and say it to her.
strings.아, 혹시 결계를 해제하고 마석을 각인한 존재를 보셨나요?: Oh, did you see the being who removed the barrier and engraved the magic stones?
strings.지엔디아가 떠올라 그 질문을 잠시 망각했군. 미안하다. 그는 아가슈라가: Thinking of Jiendia made me forget your question. I'm sorry. He shouted about how glad he was to have become an Agasura. Ah, those sharp eyes... Once seen, they were impossible to forget.
strings.내가 기억하는 건 이 정도군. 서둘러 그녀에게 전해다오. 도움이 되어야: That's all I remember. Hurry and tell her. I hope it will help...
Yes, I will. So... you must see Her Majesty again...
strings.정말… 정말 기이 태자님이 살아 계신다구요?: Prince Guiyi is really... really alive?
strings.육체와 영혼이 강제로 분리되어 원래의 자리를 찾지 못하고 있는 상황이라: He said his body and soul were forcibly separated and cannot return to their proper places.
strings.그리고 붉은 장발에 매서운 눈을 지닌 아가슈라 일족 남자가 범인이라 말씀: And he said the culprit was an Agasura man with long red hair and piercing eyes.
What? A man with long red hair? Among the Agasura I know, there is no one like that...
strings.아무래도 기이 태자님을 뵙는 일은 조금 미뤄야 할 것 같네요. 제가 한: I think I must postpone seeing Prince Guiyi a little longer. I'll look into this myself.
strings.탐의 마석을 가지고 오셨나요?: Did you bring Tam's magic stone?
strings.용경 제국의 언어로 '타락한 용'을 뜻합니다. 과거에도 타락한 용이 존재: In the language of the Yong Gyoung Empire, it means 'fallen dragon.' They say fallen dragons existed in the past too.
Show Tam's magic stone to Lady Leilei.
strings.많은 것을 아시는 분이니 그 거대한 마석을 보면 분명 정체불명의 아가슈라: She knows so much. If she sees that enormous stone, she'll surely be able to tell us about the unidentified Agasura man too.
Ah, yes. I'll go see her.
strings.(대체 럭스라는 존재는 왜 이곳에 오려고 했던 거지…?): (Why did that being Lux want to come here...?)
strings.흐아아암~! 일도 잘 끝난 거 같고 이대로 돌아가면 되나?: Yaaawn! It looks like everything has gone well. Can I head home now?
Ugh. I was trying to slip away without Jiendia catching me...
strings.어쩔 수 없지. 후우…. %s, 무슨 일이야?: No helping it. Sigh... %s, what is it?
strings.왜 그렇게 귀찮은 표정이세요?: Why do you look so bothered?
strings.일단 큰 일이 끝나서 쉬고 싶어서…. 하여튼, 빨리 이야기 해. 이 호선: The major work is done, and I'd like to rest... Anyway, hurry up and tell me. This Tiger Immortal wants to go home and relax!
Her Majesty told me to show you this magic stone.
Jiendia really does have an eye for people... no, for immortals.
strings.상태가 이상한 것 같은데, 괜찮아?: You look strange. Are you all right?
Probably the aftereffects of the battle. I think I'll be fine after some rest.
All right. Then I'll examine it.
strings.이 마석…. 이상해. 보통은 하나에 한 가지 속성이 부여되는데, 이 마석: This magic stone... is strange. Usually a stone is given only one attribute, but this one has more than the distinctive energy of the Agasura...
I can sense the demon realm in it too...
strings.이건 대체 무슨 의미지? 최근에 럭스의 움직임은 포착되지 않았어. 아가슈: What does this mean? We haven't detected any movements from Lux recently. Demon-realm energy in an Agasura's magic stone...
So there is something behind it.
strings.빨리 가서 지엔디아에게 전해. 아무래도 심상치 않다고. 럭스와 또 다른: Hurry and tell Jiendia that something is wrong. If Lux and another Agasura have joined forces, we're certainly in trouble.
I'll return and investigate what's happening.
strings.(레이레이의 이야기를 들은 지엔디아가 짐짓 놀란다.): (Jiendia is visibly surprised by Leilei's findings.)
What Agasura would dare do this...?
strings.혹시 소문으로만 듣던 아가슈라, 초엔 팜이 한 짓은 아닐까요?: Could it be Choen Palm, the Agasura I've only heard rumors about?
Your Majesty, Choen Palm has already...
strings.(초엔 팜에 관한 짧은 이야기를 들은 지엔디아가 알겠다는 표정으로 바라본: (After hearing a brief account of Choen Palm, Jiendia looks as though she understands.)
strings.%s, 알겠어요. 이제 전 용제성 정리가 끝나는 대로 돌아가 바로 조사단: %s, I understand. As soon as we've finished clearing the palace, I'll return and establish an investigation team.
strings.필요한 부분에 대해선 요청을 드려도 될까요?: May I ask for your help when needed?
I have to find a girl named Iris.
strings.아, 이리스 양을 찾는다는 이야기를 들었어요. 조사하면서 이리스 양을: Ah, I've heard that you're looking for her. If our investigation turns up any clue to Iris's whereabouts, I'll tell you immediately.
Thank you, Your Majesty. I'll wait to hear from you.
Thank you, %s. We have much to do.
strings.붉은 장발의 아가슈라 남자의 행방도 찾아야 하고, 럭스가 무슨 일을 꾸미: We must find the Agasura man with long red hair and discover what Lux is plotting...
I'll contact you soon. Please wait for my message.
